text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that overnight on-street permit parking be introduced on Northview Avenue from Victoria Park Avenue to Blantyre Avenue, 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., daily. Residents requested the implementation of overnight on-street permit parking on Northview Avenue from Victoria Park Avenue to Blantyre Avenue, to accommodate their parking needs.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized parking by permit only from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. daily on the odd (south) side of Northview Avenue from Victoria Park Avenue to Blantyre Avenue. 2. Prohibited parking at all times on the north side of Northview Avenue between Victoria Park Avenue and Blantyre Avenue.
